name: ompf_score
description: Fixed-formula OmpF porin permeation score from molecular size and net charge and primary amine count where higher means more favourable passage

name: ompf_percentile
description: Percentile of the OmpF score among 73154 CO-ADD reference molecules where higher means more favourable passage

name: ompf_cut
description: Call of 1 when the OmpF percentile is at least 0.95 and 0 otherwise

name: multiporin_score
description: Random forest multi-porin permeation score where higher means more favourable passage

name: multiporin_percentile
description: Percentile of the multi-porin score among 73154 CO-ADD reference molecules where higher means more favourable passage

name: multiporin_cut
description: Call of 1 when the multi-porin percentile is at least 0.98 and 0 otherwise

name: lipid_score
description: Random forest probability from the CO-ADD lpxC case-control that the outer membrane holds the molecule back where higher means more held back

name: lipid_percentile
description: Percentile of the reversed lipid-route score among 73154 CO-ADD reference molecules where higher means the outer membrane holds the molecule back less

name: lipid_cut
description: Call of 1 when the lipid-route percentile is at least 0.99 and 0 otherwise

name: efflux_score
description: Logistic regression probability from the CO-ADD tolC case-control that the molecule is pumped out where higher means more efflux

name: efflux_percentile
description: Percentile of the reversed efflux score among 73154 CO-ADD reference molecules where higher means less efflux

name: activity_score
description: XGBoost probability of Escherichia coli growth inhibition at MIC of 8 ug/mL or lower trained on ChEMBL

name: activity_percentile
description: Percentile of the activity score among 73154 CO-ADD reference molecules where higher means more likely active

name: activity_call
description: Call of 1 when the activity score is at least 0.50 and 0 otherwise
